spike_plan.kill_if: No trimmed build succeeds offline, or the base already passes most new-feature probes so the untouched start does not score 0.
spike_plan.pass_if: Trimmed build completes offline in under 60 min, ctest is deterministic, and the base fails every new-feature probe case.
steps: Clone eProsima/Fast-DDS at tag v3.6.2 (expect commit 3930384) into a throwaway container with network; record the commit and reconcile with the seed's 51521ef.
Confirm LICENSE is Apache-2.0 from the file itself.
Build a trimmed target: core library and tests only, no BlackboxTest, with libasio-dev, libtinyxml2-dev, libssl-dev. Time it; target under 60 min on 8 cores.
Run ctest -E BlackboxTest twice to confirm per-test results are deterministic.
Write a 20-line driver against the public ContentFilteredTopic API that feeds BETWEEN, %n parameters and simple comparisons into the existing DDSSQLFilter.
Run 30 probe expressions covering only the seed's NEW features (LIKE, MATCH, member access, enum/array/sequence, rebinding). Record base pass/fail counts.
Check whether later upstream commits or the GHSA-7577 fix touch DDSSQLFilter; list the files.
Draft the dynamic-replacement API signature and freeze it before writing any hidden test.

v1.summary: Real, Apache-2.0 Fast DDS project with a valid v3.6.2 tag, but the seed's commit pin 51521ef is not that tag (it resolves to 3930384), and Fast DDS already ships a DDSSQLFilter with BETWEEN, AND/OR/NOT and %n parameters, so the base will pass part of the graded surface unless grading is restricted to the new features. Not killed, but blocked until the pin is fixed, the dynamic-replacement API is specified, and the trimmed build and base-fails-new-features check pass in the spike.

v2.note: The paper trail fails. No upstream issue or PR asks for this feature, and the pin is wrong: 51521ef is not the v3.6.2 tag, which is 3930384. The base already ships DDSSQLFilter with BETWEEN, AND/OR/NOT and %n parameters. As far as I know (not verified) it also covers LIKE/MATCH, member/array access, and runtime expression and parameter changes through the ContentFilteredTopic API. If so, most of the 'feature' is already there, and the base would not score 0. The smoke build is red, and a trimmed offline build of a 150 MB C++ repo is unproven. The deliverable's API is still unspecified.
